name: ACE Edutrend Limited
about: ACE Edutrend Limited offers educational and vocational services in India. It also manages educational institutes, training institutes, and centres, as well as acts as consultants, contractors, advisors, surveyors and assessors, representations, and liaison agents. In addition, it involved in various projects and programs. The company was formerly known as Ace India Limited and changed its name to ACE Edutrend Limited in November 2010. ACE Edutrend Limited was incorporated in 1993 and is based in New Delhi, India.
